Maximum Outstanding Requests.description: The maximum number of HTTP requests that can be outstanding at any one time. Any attempt to register an additional HTTP Request will cause an error
Maximum Outstanding Requests.name: Maximum Outstanding Requests

Request Expiration.description: Specifies how long an HTTP Request should be left unanswered before being evicted from the cache and being responded to with a Service Unavailable status code
Request Expiration.name: Request Expiration

typeDescription: Provides the ability to store and retrieve HTTP requests and responses external to a Processor, so that multiple Processors can interact with the same HTTP request.
